user.title: New template group
user.description: Sensors in this group are recalculated together on a fixed interval, in order. Later sensors can read earlier ones in the same tick with states('sensor.xxx'). Source changes do not trigger a recalculation.

data_description.name: Name of the helper group shown as a device in Home Assistant.
data_description.interval: How often every sensor in the group is recalculated, in seconds (minimum 1).

add_template.title: Add template sensor {position}

data_description.name: Friendly name of the sensor. The entity ID is derived from this name.
data_description.template: Home Assistant Jinja template. Later sensors in this group can read this one in the same tick after it has been written.
data_description.state_class: Optional. Use measurement, total or total_increasing for statistics.

add_combine.title: Add combine sensor {position}

data_description.name: Friendly name of the sensor. The entity ID is derived from this name.
data_description.entity_ids: Entities whose numeric states are combined on each tick.
data_description.combine_type: sum, mean, min, max, median, last (most recently updated) or range.
data_description.round_digits: How many digits to keep after the decimal point.
data_description.state_class: Optional. Use measurement, total or total_increasing for statistics.
